visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed campaign stage with text directly on a background image or muted looping background video
traits: full-bleed stage, 810px tall on all breakpoints
background image, optionally a muted looping background video without controls
pause/play toggle for the background video, revealed on hover/focus
default: text directly on the media over a dark gradient overlay, vertically centred, left
option right: text in a white card at the right edge, vertically centred

contentPattern.structure: 1 column. Row 1: background image (poster), optionally followed by a link to an .mp4 file that plays as a muted, looping, inline background video without controls (started only after the page has loaded; not started for users who prefer reduced motion, who keep the poster). Row 2: heading (H1 on the page stage, H2 further down), optional subtitle (a short plain paragraph of up to 100 characters directly after the heading), optional text paragraph(s), optional CTA link (bold link = primary button, any other link = secondary button). Default: text on the left of the image over a dark gradient overlay. Option right: text in a white card at the right of the image (no overlay). Text is always vertically centred. A pause/play toggle is shown while a background video is present; its labels default to 'Pause background video' / 'Play background video' (EN) and 'Hintergrundvideo anhalten' / 'Hintergrundvideo abspielen' (DE) and can be overridden with optional trailing rows 'Pause label | ...' and 'Play label | ...'. Defensive: the first image anywhere is the background, the first .mp4 link the video, everything else is text; rows may be merged or split.

usage: Campaign stages on /de/en/100-years (page stage with background video and H1; timeline uplift with image and H2, option right). Expected on 100-years sub-pages, stopover, offers and trade-fair pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any full-bleed stage with text on the media (default) or in a white card at the right (option right). For a solid text card elsewhere use hero-card-overlay.
